ValidationRule.description: Blocks the legacy CPQ Send with Adobe Sign path (ASSFCPQ__Quote_Document__c set): always when the document is the Subscription Order Form itself; from 11 Oct 2026 on any in-scope quote. Send for Signature never sets it. Bypass: Order_Form_Guard_Bypass.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED( ASSFCPQ__Quote_Document__c ) ), NOT( ISBLANK( ASSFCPQ__Quote_Document__c ) ), NOT( $Permission.Order_Form_Guard_Bypass ), OR( ASSFCPQ__Quote_Document__r.SBQQ__QuoteTemplate__r.Name = "Subscription Order Form", AND( TODAY() >= DATE(2026, 10, 11), ASSFCPQ__Quote_Document__r.SBQQ__Quote__r.Order_Form_Scoped__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Press Save, not Send to Adobe Sign. Then go back to the quote and press Send for Signature: the Subscription Order Form is sent from there so the customer's PO and VAT are written back. Questions: the CRM team.
